messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started (config-only) — rollout id 4498765432
deploy-bot: Config set: \u201cthin-throttle-v1.2\u201d targets=prod canary=2% change-window=30m pinned_routes=enterprise:true
anya: ack, watching latency + errors. will notify if p95 > 1s or errors > 0.1%
sam: grabbing dashboards: http://grafana.company/r/serving?var=env=prod
tess: quick question — are we early-draining legacy pool or gradual ramp?
jorge: propose 2% -> 10% after 10m if p50 < 200ms and errors < 0.05%
anya: +1. add alarm for KV cache miss spike (last config caused pressure)
deploy-bot: Observability hook attached: `rollout.watch --id 4498765432 --metrics=p50,p95,error_rate,kv_miss`
sam: pulling KV cache and queue_depth panels now
tess: if kv_miss spikes > 3x baseline, rollback command: `deploy rollback 4498765432`
anya: who is primary oncall? @sam? @tess? I'm oncall in 30m
sam: I'm primary for next 40m, tess is secondary
deploy-bot: Canary reached 2% -> status=green
sam: metrics check (10m): p50=118ms, p95=430ms, errors=0.012%, kv_miss flat
jorge: go to 10% now if everyone is good
deploy-bot: Rolling to 10%...
notice-bot: watchlist set -> [kv_cache_miss, queue_depth, model_qps]
tess: also pin routing override for enterprise keys to previous pool until we confirm user-facing stability: `route_overrides.enterprise = pinned: true`
anya: noted and added to the incident channel if anything spikes
sam: 10% steady for 15m. No anomaly. p95 trending down slightly
deploy-bot: Auto-check passed: latency & error thresholds OK -> ramping to 50%
sam: holding at 50% for 10m per change-window plan, will not exceed without thumbs up
jorge: gating rule: if p95 > 1000ms OR errors > 0.1% -> immediate rollback
tess: small config snippet we changed:
```
{
  "batching": { "max_batch_size": 8, "timeout_ms": 25 },
  "routing": { "short_requests_policy": "thin-path" },
  "rate_limits": { "per_token": 0.0009 }
}
```
anya: drafting release-note blurb: "Config-only: adjusted batching/timeouts and routing policy to reduce tail latency for short requests. No model changes."
sam: 50% stable for 20m. metrics: p50=125ms, p95=480ms, errors=0.015%
deploy-bot: Rolling remainder to 100% over 5m window
deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> status=done, id=4498765432
sam: marking thread resolved. pushed release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/123
tess: :thumbsup: thanks all, will follow up if customers report anything
anya: leaving a quick post-mortem checklist in the channel tomorrow to capture tuning rationale
jorge: noted. nice and quiet rollout, good job everyone
